tr.title: Stablecoinler Nasil Deger Korur ve Riskleri Nedir
slides: Stablecoinler fiat para veya baska varliklara baglanarak degerlerini korur.
En yaygin mekanizmalar tam altin teminatlı, kredi teminatlı ve algoritmik sistemlerdir.
Teminat duvarlarinin altinda kalan varliklarin guvenilirligi ve on-demand cigneme yeteneği kritiktir.
Bir stablecoinin bagimliliği yüksek olduğunda likidite krizleri ve deger kaymasi riski artar.
tr.caption:

en.title: How Stablecoins Hold Their Value and What Risks They Carry
slides: Stablecoins maintain their value by being pegged to fiat currency or other assets.
The most common mechanisms are full reserve backing, credit backed, and algorithmic systems.
The quality of the underlying reserve assets and the ability to redeem on demand are critical.
When a stablecoin's backing becomes fragile, liquidity crises and value depegging risks increase.
en.caption:
Stablecoins use reserve, credit, or algorithmic mechanisms to maintain their value. The reliability and transparency of these mechanisms are the most important factors for users. $BTC $ETH $USDT
